title: Sculk Step
description: A simple datapack that spreads a small sculk patch where you step. Made for roleplay purposes, aiming to be as unintrusive as possible.
body:
A simple datapack that spreads a small sculk patch where you step. Made for roleplay purposes, aiming to be as unintrusive as possible.

To use, you must make and add the player you wish to be affected to team "sculk".

May not work as intended if multiple players are on the sculk team.
